_doc: Baked by tools/valley/valley_plan.py --bake from config/valley.json (never edit by hand). heights.r16.gz: gzip of little-endian uint16, `width` per row, rows north to south (z0 first), columns west to east (x0 first); point (i, j) is at x = x0 + i * spacing, z = z0 + j * spacing; its height is offset + scale * value.
